title: csv_multiturn_create_then_transpose
prompts:
Create datauser/test_spreadsheet/scores.csv with exactly this CSV content:
Student,Maths,Science,English,History
Alice,85,92,78,88
Bob,76,88,91,74
Carol,94,85,89,91
Dave,67,78,82,70

now transpose that file so subjects are rows and students are columns. The output header must be Subject,Alice,Bob,Carol,Dave,Eve, followed by one row each for Maths, Science, English, and History using the corresponding scores from the source file. Save as datauser/test_spreadsheet/scores_transposed.csv and include the full path and exact CSV contents in your reply.
